Scope per requirement-analysis.md NFR-11: storefront (screens 1–4) is responsive across phone/tablet/laptop and equivalent in browser vs. installed-PWA states; admin (screen 5) is laptop-primary with a supported tablet layout, phone admin deferred. Wireframes stay the low-fidelity structural reference — docs/design-direction.html remains
the source of truth for final visual styling once that direction is confirmed.
